definition: Finite-window uncentered pair increment cosine:sum_t(dx_i dot dx_j)/sqrt(sum_t|dx_i|^2 sum_t|dx_j|^2),12 increments including last observation to first future.Not mean-subtracted DCCM or equilibrium covariance.Whole-protein alignment to the fixed last observation matches existing scores.
pairs: All unique covalent edges with valid atoms;CA pairs selected only from observed distance shell4.5..8A,max4096 fixed-seed pairs per condition.Pairs never selected from true/generated future.

findings: A improves both covalent and observed CA-contact increment-cosine errors over h/v,B and PVB in both seeds.The mean covalent cosine is close to MD,but nonzero per-pair errors prevent claiming the full coupling pattern is correct.

A also improves CA-contact relative-increment fair path scores over h/v/PVB in both seeds;its covalent relative-increment fair score differences versus these references remain unresolved.Do not substitute favorable directional summaries for a distributional improvement on every observable.

B improves CA-contact cosine error over h/v but worsens covalent cosine error and covalent relative-increment fair score in both seeds.B versus PVB improves covalent cosine error but worsens CA-contact cosine error;directional and distributional scores have tradeoffs.

PVB has lower common-step amplitudes and weaker mean covalent coupling than MD despite much better bond/clash geometry.This is counterevidence to treating the released reference as correct on every motion observable.

Spatial cooperation and temporal continuity are distinct:both A seeds show strong within-step neighbor coordination while their previously measured CA temporal-order gains remain near0.02 versus MD0.285.A blanket claim that all atom motions are independent is unsupported.

These findings favor investigating how spatially coordinated features are propagated across query times if the temporal deficit persists after static pretraining.They do not prove a unique architecture root cause or justify adding many spatial layers without a controlled comparison.
limitations: Single future per condition and two generated draws;finite-window pair-cosine MAE is descriptive,not a proper distribution score or equilibrium DCCM.
Alignment can induce correlations;all models/MD use the same observed-reference fit.No separate residue fits or coordinate repair.
Defined-pair fraction is1 for all learned models and MD;zero for exact persistence.Persisting coordinates receive undefined cosine,not an artificial perfect score.
